text: Though destitute, He is the source of all wealth; though the Lord of the three worlds, He dwells in the abodes of the ancestors. Though of terrifying aspect, He is called auspicious; for there are none who truly know the truth. Whether adorned with ornaments, or a devotee of pleasure, or one who wears a tiger-skin and a torn garment, or a bearer of a skull, or one crowned with the crescent moon—the form of the Universal Being cannot be definitively determined.
